who: Robert Tauwinkl is an individual architect based in Bucharest, running a private architectural office (Birou Individual de Arhitectura) that offers full architectural, structural, and installation design services, including technical documentation for building permits. His work focuses on residential, industrial, zootechnical, office, and tourism architecture.
fit_reason: While Robert Tauwinkl is an architect in Romania (Bucharest) who could theoretically serve diaspora clients, there is no explicit signal in the source indicating he targets or has experience with Romanian diaspora clients building homes abroad. The page is a generic directory listing with no mention of international clients, remote monitoring, diaspora outreach, or services tailored to non-resident Romanians. Without evidence of diaspora engagement, he is a low-probability fit — though architects in mid-size cities (per ICP) are more likely candidates than those in Bucharest unless they specifically market to expats.
